subjects.description: A russet fox with a full winter coat, black lower legs, and a white-tipped tail walking along a packed snow path.
subjects.appearance_details: Frost on the guard hairs, amber eyes, breath visible in the cold air. Paw prints trail behind it in the packed snow.
subjects.relationship: Primary subject moving through the forest
subjects.location: Center of frame on the trail
subjects.orientation: Approaching the camera, body angled slightly to the left
subjects.pose: Four-beat walk with the tail held level
subjects.action: Walking the trail, pausing once to scent the air, then continuing
subjects.state_changes: Snow on the coat sheds in small clumps as the fox moves; breath plumes appear and fade
subjects.facial_features: Narrow muzzle, black nose, whiskers catching frost

subjects.description: A snow-covered pine forest flanking a narrow packed trail, with a pale gold dawn sky between the trunks.
subjects.appearance_details: Blue shadows in the drifts, snow clinging to needles, scattered fallen cones along the path edge.
subjects.location: Full background and both sides of the trail
subjects.relative_size: Fills the frame beyond the fox
subjects.action: Loose snow drifts from branches in a light breeze
subjects.state_changes: Dawn light warms from cool blue to a faint gold on the upper trunks

background_setting: A quiet boreal trail at dawn. Packed snow underfoot, deep powder in the understory, and tall pines forming a corridor. No buildings, vehicles, or people.

lighting.conditions: Soft dawn light, low sun not yet in frame, cool shadows with a warm rim on snow-facing trunks
lighting.direction: Key light from the far end of the trail, slightly above and ahead of the fox
lighting.shadows: Long, soft shadows of trunks across the path; the fox casts a short shadow to its right
lighting.illumination_effect: Clear winter morning with gentle contrast and visible breath in the cold air

aesthetics.composition: Fox centered on the trail with converging pine trunks leading into the distance
aesthetics.color_scheme: Russet, cream, pine green, and cool white with a hint of dawn gold
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating vertical trunks and textured snow

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow lateral track matching the fox's walk, with a slight push-in during the scent pause
cinematography.framing: Medium-wide shot holding the fox and nearby trunks
cinematography.camera_angle: Eye level with the fox, roughly 50 cm above the snow
cinematography.focus: Sharp on the fox's face and forelegs; distant trees slightly soft

context: A short text-to-video benchmark clip of a fox walking a snowy pine trail at dawn

actions.description: The fox enters along the packed trail, walking toward the camera with a steady gait
The fox stops, lifts its muzzle, and scents the air while snow falls from a nearby branch
The fox resumes walking; the camera keeps pace as dawn light warms the far trunks

segments.key_changes: Fox becomes the clear subject; paw prints accumulate behind it
Motion of the body stops; head lifts; a breath plume appears

segments.description: Walk resumes to the end of the clip
segments.key_changes: Gait returns; more snow sheds from the coat

temporal_caption: At dawn a russet fox walks a packed snow trail between pines. In the first two seconds it approaches at a steady walk. Around two to three seconds it pauses and scents the air, breath visible in the cold. In the last two seconds it continues forward as the camera tracks beside it and the sky brightens between the trunks.
